title: Your Kid Didn't Call You. AI Did.
description:
Your mum gets a call in your voice, crying. You never made it. Lenny shows exactly how the cloned-voice scam works — where the voice comes from, the panic script, the fake officer handoff, the money — plus three more AI tricks (fake boss video calls, deepfake celebrity ads, "AI trading bots") and the family code word that beats them all.
